title: INTRODUCTION TO FLUID MECHANICS AND HEAT TRANSFER
description: Introduces basic concepts of fluid dynamics and heat transfer. Applies conservation equations and dimensional analysis to solve engineering problems relevant to incompressible pipe systems and external flows, as well as conductive, convective, and radiative heat transfer. CROSSLISTED as ME 330/NSE 330.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: ME 310 or NSE 310.
A minimum grade of C is required in ME 310 and NSE 310.

Enrollment limited to students in the College of Engineering college.
